management.src: Close at profit >= 25% of max profit, i.e. when mark >= debit + 0.25*(width - debit), for DTE > 5.
For 0-2 DTE flies, close at profit >= 50% of max profit or when mark >= 2.0x the debit paid, whichever triggers first.
Hard stop: close if mark <= 50% of net debit (loss >= 50% of capital at risk) and spot is outside both wings.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: the 2 short body calls must be bought back or the whole structure closed no later than 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally, at market if necessary, even at max loss.

DIVIDEND GUARD: if the underlying goes ex-dividend before expiry and the short body calls are ITM with extrinsic < the declared dividend, close the position before the close of the day prior to the ex-date.
PIN GUARD: if at 15:30 ET on expiry day |spot - body strike| < 0.25% of spot, close the entire fly immediately; do not attempt to capture the last of the tent.
Time exit: close any fly with > 0 DTE remaining at 2 DTE if neither the profit target nor the stop has been hit.

unexpressed.text: Net debit must be <= 20% of wing width (e.g. pay <= $1.00 on a $5-wide fly), giving a minimum 4:1 theoretical reward/risk.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Both wings must be exactly equal width; reject the order if strike spacing differs by even one increment.
unexpressed.reason: structural: the template enforces this shape, so there is nothing for a predicate to check

unexpressed.text: Submit as a single 3-strike multi-leg (4-contract) order, limit at the natural mid, willing to pay mid + $0.02 per unit; never leg in.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: Max 1.5% of account equity at risk per butterfly; max 5% of equity across all open butterflies on one underlying.

unexpressed.text: No entry if an earnings report, FOMC statement, or CPI print falls between now and expiry unless the fly is deliberately an event pin trade.
unexpressed.reason: conditional exception clause: the IR has no way to attach an 'unless' to a compiled predicate without an expression language

safety_gaps.why: the document names a stop and none compiled. A strategy that looks armed and is missing its stop is the failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent.
